workload: Standard production QEMU/RPi5 linked images and the QEMU main lane boot, before (87517a32) and after (b1897562) per-bucket block cache write retirement. Accounting boundaries: fixed image sections, allocator start pages, and block-device reads per boot. Pools, slots, allocation paths and retained pages are unchanged.
assessment: Adopt: 2 KiB of per-core per-bucket write counts (QEMU .bss +2048, RPi5 .bss +4096 with alignment, RPi5 allocator 8 pages fewer) buy a 79 percent cut in single-block device reads (6132 -> 1299) and 62 percent in total device reads (226297 -> 85411) on the QEMU main boot. Cache slot count and data size unchanged. RPi5 read latency was not measured in this review.
next_trigger: Measure at a change to block cache slot or bucket count, a changed allocation workload, or completion of the safe-memory stage.
